load_dinov2_model: load a pretrained DINOv2 vision transformer model from torch hub and move it to a device
run_custom_forward_pass: run a custom forward pass on a DINOv2 model to extract cls tokens, registers, and patch features
extract_patch_features: extract patch-level feature embeddings from an image tensor using a DINOv2 model
extract_cls_token: extract the CLS token embedding from a DINOv2 model for image classification tasks
patch_model_forward: patch a DINOv2 model forward method to return structured cls, register, and patch outputs
